name: Crypto Price Widgets – Live Cryptocurrency Prices by CoinLore
author: coinlore

sections.description:
Crypto Price Widgets by CoinLore allows you to display live cryptocurrency prices, market capitalization, and coin data directly on your WordPress website.

Easily embed:

• Single Coin Price Widgets (Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, BNB, Dogecoin and more)
• Live Crypto Ticker
• Cryptocurrency Market Cap Tables
• Custom coin lists

Supports 15,000+ cryptocurrencies powered by CoinLore’s real-time crypto market data.

Live Demo:
https://www.coinlore.com/crypto-widgets

Fully compatible with:
• Gutenberg blocks
• Shortcodes
• Classic Editor
• Page builders

Key Features

• Live cryptocurrency prices (WebSocket powered)
• 15,000+ coins supported
• Server-side rendering for SEO compatibility
• Native Gutenberg block support
• Shortcode generator
• Lightweight and performance optimized
• Secure and SSL compatible
• Mobile responsive design
• No cryptojacking. No mining scripts.
• Clean, fast JavaScript with no heavy frameworks

Security & Performance

Built with performance and security in mind:

• Optimized caching layer
• Minimal dependencies
• WordPress coding best practices
• Sanitized inputs and escaped output
• Designed for financial and YMYL-sensitive content

Widget Types

  1. Single Coin Price Widget
  2. Live Crypto Ticker
  3. Cryptocurrency Table
  4. Custom Coin Lists

All widgets are fully customizable.

Gutenberg Blocks

This plugin includes native server-rendered Gutenberg blocks:

• Crypto Price Block
• Crypto Ticker Block
• Crypto Table Block

Blocks are rendered on the server for maximum SEO compatibility.

Support

Official Website:
https://www.coinlore.com/

Widget Page:
https://www.coinlore.com/crypto-widgets

Email:
contact@coinlore.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress “Plugins” menu
  3. Go to Settings → CoinLore Widgets
  4. Insert widgets using blocks or shortcodes
sections.faq:
Is the data live?

Yes. Prices are updated in real time using WebSocket technology.

Is it SEO friendly?

Yes. Widgets are server-rendered and fully crawlable by search engines.

Does it support all coins?

Yes. Over 15,000 cryptocurrencies are supported.

Does this plugin mine cryptocurrency?

No. This plugin does not include any mining or cryptojacking scripts.
